name: Miyoko's Creamery Organic Cashew Milk Mozzarella (Pourable / Block)
whyItWorks: Crafted from cultured organic cashew milk using traditional cheesemaking techniques. Melts beautifully over pizza crusts without dairy proteins or synthetic melting gums.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Shred or pour over gluten-free pizza crust or pasta and bake at 425°F until bubbly.
